source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
A unit in which any model carries a **[[CLOSE-QUARTERS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/close-quarters)** weapon may use the **[Close-Quarters Shooting](vsdata:core-rule/close-quarters-shooting)** type (10.06). With any other shooting type, each model except **MONSTER** and **VEHICLE** models must pick one set to attack with:

- its **[[CLOSE-QUARTERS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/close-quarters)** weapons
- its other ranged weapons

**[[PISTOL]](vsdata:weapon-ability/pistol)** (24.27) is the same ability.

mode.monsterVehicle: hit roll -1 unless a [CLOSE-QUARTERS] weapon targets a unit engaged with the firing unit
mode.otherModels: only [CLOSE-QUARTERS] weapons, only against units engaged with their unit
